                    <p>City of Clarence pays respect to all First Peoples, including the Mumirimina (mu mee ree mee nah) of the Oyster Bay Nation whose unceded lands, skies, and waterways we are privileged to conduct our business on. We pay respect to Elders past and present, and we acknowledge the survival and deep spiritual connection of the Tasmanian Aboriginal People to their Country, and culture; a connection that has endured since the beginning of time.</p>
<p><strong>Read our <a href="https://www.ccc.tas.gov.au/your-council/how-council-works/special-committees/reconciliation-action-plan/">Reconciliation commitment</a>.</strong></p>
